7625.title: Shared storage parent in workspace permissions
7625.rootCauseOneLine: The host adds the shared storage parent to environment-wide write roots; Claude workspace sessions copy it into additional directories and sandbox permissions while BB_THREAD_STORAGE names a per-thread child.
7625.proposedFix: Derive and grant per-thread artifact directories at the thread-aware session boundary without retaining the shared parent; preserve workspace metadata roots and review shared-provider session behavior.
7625.caveats: Verified twice at production configuration boundaries, not by running a real Claude turn or cross-thread sandbox write. No automatic PR because a fix changes permission/security boundaries. The complete harness and output are embedded in the report.
